# National parks of Sweden — provenance report

<!-- Generated from authored/swedish-national-parks.json by scripts/authored_decks.py. Do not edit: change the dossier and rebuild. -->

**Deck:** [`decks/swedish-national-parks.ttl`](../decks/swedish-national-parks.ttl) · **Cards:** 31 · **Licence:** [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) · **Compiled by:** Anton Wiklund · **Created:** 2026-10-04

All 31 national parks of Sweden as of 4 October 2026, from the nine created in 1909 to Nämdöskärgården (2025). Front: the park's name in English, or its official Swedish name; back: the county (län) it lies in, with the year it was established in a note. Tiveden lies in two counties and Färnebofjärden in four. The list and the Swedish names are those of the National Parks Ordinance (1987:938); the counties and years come from Naturvårdsverket's register of protected areas and Wikidata, checked against Sveriges nationalparker.

## Licensing

The content sources are Nationalparksförordning (1987:938), a Swedish statute and so free of copyright under 9 § of the Swedish Copyright Act, which gives the list of parks and their Swedish names; Naturvårdsregistret, whose open data Naturvårdsverket publishes under CC0, which gives the counties and dates; and Wikidata (CC0), which gives the years, the municipalities and counties and the county names. The deck is therefore CC0 1.0 like the rest of the library. Sveriges nationalparker and Naturvårdsverket's page on new parks (no licence stated), Länsstyrelsen Gotland (all rights reserved) and the Swedish Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0) were used for verification only: they confirmed facts that the content sources gave, and no wording or selection was taken from them. The English park names are the compiler's convention (the ordinance's base name plus "National Park"), which matches the Wikidata English label for 24 parks and was confirmed against the English list of Sveriges nationalparker; a park's name is a fact (a proper name), and "<name> National Park" is the form any translation takes, so no protected expression is copied. The notes are the compiler's own wording.

## Method

1. Who did the work: Anton Wiklund compiled this deck with the help of AI agents (Claude, by Anthropic), which did the research, drafting and cross-checking at his direction. The cards were checked by machine (live Wikidata and the app's SHACL and DCAT-AP validators) and in independent review rounds by further Claude agents, each logged under Quality control with its findings and how they were resolved. Anton Wiklund reviews every deck in full before it is released.
2. 1. The list of parks: Nationalparksförordning (1987:938), the government ordinance that names Sweden's national parks, was downloaded from the Riksdag's statute database (query 13). Its 1 § lists 31 parks, numbered 1 (Vadvetjåkka) to 31 (Nämdöskärgården, added by SFS 2025:721); the page states the text as amended up to SFS 2025:749. The 31 names in 1 § are the deck's selection and its Swedish fronts, written exactly as the ordinance writes them ("Sareks nationalpark", "Stora Sjöfallets (Stuor Muorkke) nationalpark"). Its 3 § says which county administrative board manages the parts of Tiveden and Färnebofjärden that lie in other counties. The cards are in the ordinance's order.
3. 2. Wikidata: query 1 fetched every item in Sweden (P17 Q34) that is an instance of national park (Q46169) or a subclass, with its inception (P571). It returned 32 items: the 31 parks of the ordinance and Kungliga nationalstadsparken (Royal National City Park, Q1796166), an instance of national urban park (Q10594812), a different protection form, which was left out. Query 4 fetched each park's Naturvårdsregistret ID (P3613). Query 2 fetched the parks' location statements (P131, P276, P706): every park has P131 statements for its municipalities (Nämdöskärgården only for its county). Query 3 looked for any statement that links items to Sweden's provinces (landskap, Q193556); the parks have none apart from Kosterhavet's P276 Bohuslän, so no CC0 source gives the provinces (see step 7). Query 5 fetched the county (an instance of Q200547) of every municipality the parks are in, with the county's English and Swedish labels; query 6 (the Wikidata API) fetched the parks' English, Swedish and mul labels and aliases.
4. 3. Naturvårdsregistret: for each park the current record was fetched from Naturvårdsverket's REST API (query 7, https://geodata.naturvardsverket.se/naturvardsregistret/rest/v3/omrade/<P3613 ID>/Gällande), which gives the name, the protection type ("Nationalpark" for all 31), the county (lanAsText), the municipalities (kommunerAsText) and the original decision date (ursprBeslutsdatum, milliseconds since 1970 at Swedish midnight, converted to a date). The terms of the data (CC0) were read in Naturvårdsverket's description of the register's open data (query 8).
5. 4. Sveriges nationalparker: Naturvårdsverket's national-park site was fetched (query 9): its list page says "Sveriges 31 nationalparker" and links 31 park pages, the same 31 parks as the ordinance. Each park page was downloaded and the facts at its top extracted ("Bildades 1909" or "Bildad 1918"; "Län Norrbotten", or several counties). Its English list of parks (https://www.sverigesnationalparker.se/en/parks) gives the English names ("Sarek National Park", "Haparanda Skärgård National Park"). (The address https://www.naturvardsverket.se/amnesomraden/skyddad-natur/nationalparker/ answered 404 and was not used.)
6. 5. Swedish Wikipedia: the article linked from each park's Wikidata item was fetched with its revision id through the MediaWiki API (query 10), and the infobox field "inrättad" (year established) read where the article has it (27 of 31).
7. 6. Cut-off: Naturvårdsverket's page on new national parks (reviewed 30 April 2026) and Länsstyrelsen Gotland's page on the proposed Bästeträsk national park (latest news 2026-01-13) were read (queries 11 and 11b): Nämdöskärgården (2025) is the 31st and newest park, and Bästeträsk, proposed in August 2025, has not been decided. A web search for national parks created in 2026 found nothing else.
8. 7. Card text. Front, Swedish: the name in the ordinance. Front, English: the compiler's own convention, the park's base name as in the ordinance's Swedish name (without the genitive -s and without "nationalpark") followed by "National Park" ("Sareks nationalpark" → "Sarek National Park"). For 24 parks this equals the Wikidata English label, which the builder checks; all 31 were confirmed against the English list of Sveriges nationalparker. For the three parks whose names include a Sami name, the ordinance's brackets are kept ("Muddus (Muttos) National Park"), where the site writes a slash ("Muddus/Muttos National Park"), so that both languages give the same name. For four parks the Wikidata English label is a translation or another word order ("Haparanda Archipelago National Park", "Blå Jungfrun national park", "National Park Åsnen", "Nämdö archipelago national park"); their fronts keep the Swedish base name like the others, as Sveriges nationalparker's English list does. Back: the county or counties the park lies in, as Naturvårdsregistret, Wikidata (the counties of the parks' municipalities) and Sveriges nationalparker give them; for the two parks in several counties, the counties are listed in Swedish alphabetical order ("Västra Götaland and Örebro counties" / "Västra Götalands och Örebro län"). The English and Swedish county names are the Wikidata labels of the county items ("Skåne County" / "Skåne län"), as in the deck sweden-counties-and-provinces. The brief asked for the province (landskap) instead; the provinces are not recorded for the parks by the ordinance, Naturvårdsregistret, Sveriges nationalparker or Wikidata, and several parks' provinces would have had to be inferred from maps or taken from Wikipedia, so the deck gives the counties, which every official source states. Note: "Established <year>" / "Bildad <year>", the year Sveriges nationalparker gives, equal to the year of Wikidata's P571; for Nämdöskärgården the note adds that it is the 31st park.
9. 8. Cross-checks: a script (<scratch>/make_dossier.py) built the cards from the downloaded files and stopped on any disagreement: every name in 1 § had to match the card; the Naturvårdsregistret record had to belong to the Wikidata item (P3613); the set of counties of the Wikidata municipalities had to equal the card's counties; the year on Sveriges nationalparker had to equal the Wikidata P571 year. All 31 cards passed. The county on Naturvårdsregistret and on Sveriges nationalparker, the 3 § text and the Wikipedia year were compared by reading; the differences are in quality-control round 0. The builder runs each card's Wikidata checks against live Wikidata: the park's Naturvårdsregistret ID, inception year and municipalities, each municipality's county, the English and Swedish labels of each county, and the park's English and Swedish label or alias where it equals the card's name.

## Selection

Every national park of Sweden as of 4 October 2026: the 31 parks listed in 1 § of Nationalparksförordning (1987:938) as amended up to SFS 2025:749, the same 31 that Sveriges nationalparker, Naturvårdsregistret and Wikidata give. The newest is Nämdöskärgården (2025). Left out: Kungliga nationalstadsparken (the Royal National City Park in Stockholm), a national urban park, a different form of protection, not a national park; proposed parks not yet decided (Bästeträsk on Gotland, proposed in August 2025 and still with the government); nature reserves and other protected areas; and the parks' provinces (landskap), which no official source records for them (see method step 7). Extensions of parks after their creation (such as Tiveden's in 2017) do not change the year in the note, which is the year the park was established.

## Queries

**1. National parks in Sweden with inception and labels (sh <scratch>/run.sh q1; run.sh runs: curl -s -H "User-Agent: solid-memo deck research (https://github.com/antwika/solid-memo)" -H "Accept: text/csv" --data-urlencode query@<scratch>/q1.rq https://query.wikidata.org/sparql > <scratch>/q1.csv)** (Wikidata: the national parks of Sweden (instances of national park (Q46169) or its Swedish subclass Q108051174 with country Sweden), with their Naturvårdsregistret ID (P3613), inception (P571), location (P131) and labels, and the counties of their municipalities)

```
SELECT ?park ?en ?sv ?class ?classLabel ?inception ?dissolved WHERE {
  ?park wdt:P31 ?class ; wdt:P17 wd:Q34 .
  ?class wdt:P279* wd:Q46169 .
  OPTIONAL { ?park wdt:P571 ?inception }
  OPTIONAL { ?park wdt:P576 ?dissolved }
  OPTIONAL { ?park rdfs:label ?en FILTER(LANG(?en) = "en") }
  OPTIONAL { ?park rdfs:label ?sv FILTER(LANG(?sv) = "sv") }
  OPTIONAL { ?class rdfs:label ?classLabel FILTER(LANG(?classLabel) = "en") }
}
ORDER BY ?sv

```

**2. The parks' location statements (P131, P276, P706) and the classes of their values (sh <scratch>/run.sh q2, run like query 1 with <scratch>/q2.rq and <scratch>/q2.csv)** (Wikidata: the national parks of Sweden (instances of national park (Q46169) or its Swedish subclass Q108051174 with country Sweden), with their Naturvårdsregistret ID (P3613), inception (P571), location (P131) and labels, and the counties of their municipalities)

```
SELECT ?park ?sv ?prop ?value ?valueSv ?valueClass WHERE {
  VALUES ?park { wd:Q953092 wd:Q119150 wd:Q32225934 wd:Q962373 wd:Q640485 wd:Q761264 wd:Q1505461 wd:Q761227 wd:Q17745939 wd:Q569960 wd:Q1891973 wd:Q1438951 wd:Q580404 wd:Q1968993 wd:Q121842769 wd:Q692011 wd:Q666044 wd:Q945780 wd:Q1754183 wd:Q691597 wd:Q1566469 wd:Q1505447 wd:Q1398891 wd:Q1530442 wd:Q391929 wd:Q1270469 wd:Q1544161 wd:Q1673310 wd:Q1754204 wd:Q1568129 wd:Q27027158 }
  VALUES ?prop { wdt:P131 wdt:P276 wdt:P706 wdt:P7938 }
  ?park ?prop ?value .
  OPTIONAL { ?park rdfs:label ?sv FILTER(LANG(?sv) = "sv") }
  OPTIONAL { ?value rdfs:label ?valueSv FILTER(LANG(?valueSv) = "sv") }
  OPTIONAL { ?value wdt:P31 ?valueClass }
}
ORDER BY ?sv ?prop

```

**3. Which properties link items to Sweden's provinces (landskap), to see whether Wikidata records the parks' provinces (sh <scratch>/run.sh q3, run like query 1 with <scratch>/q3.rq and <scratch>/q3.csv)** (Wikidata: the national parks of Sweden (instances of national park (Q46169) or its Swedish subclass Q108051174 with country Sweden), with their Naturvårdsregistret ID (P3613), inception (P571), location (P131) and labels, and the counties of their municipalities)

```
SELECT ?p (COUNT(*) AS ?n) (SAMPLE(?sLabel) AS ?example) (SAMPLE(?class) AS ?cls) WHERE {
  ?prov wdt:P31 wd:Q193556 .
  ?s ?p ?prov .
  ?s wdt:P31 ?class .
  OPTIONAL { ?s rdfs:label ?sLabel FILTER(LANG(?sLabel) = "sv") }
}
GROUP BY ?p
ORDER BY DESC(?n)
LIMIT 30

```

**4. Each park's Naturvårdsregistret ID (P3613) and coordinates (sh <scratch>/run.sh q4, run like query 1 with <scratch>/q4.rq and <scratch>/q4.csv)** (Wikidata: the national parks of Sweden (instances of national park (Q46169) or its Swedish subclass Q108051174 with country Sweden), with their Naturvårdsregistret ID (P3613), inception (P571), location (P131) and labels, and the counties of their municipalities)

## Quality control

5 rounds, 22 findings: 9 fixed, 0 rejected after checking, 13 needing no change. Every card's Wikidata checks (270 in all) are re-run against live Wikidata by `scripts/authored_decks.py check` before every build.

### Round 0: Sources, licences and machine checks: the list of parks against the ordinance, Sveriges nationalparker, Naturvårdsregistret and Wikidata; every county against Naturvårdsregistret, Wikidata's municipalities and Sveriges nationalparker; every year against Sveriges nationalparker, Wikidata, Naturvårdsregistret and the Swedish Wikipedia; the names against the ordinance, the site and Wikidata labels; the cut-off against Naturvårdsverket and Länsstyrelsen Gotland. (2026-10-04)

**Reviewer:** Claude (AI) — authoring agent, machine checks · **Scope:** All 31 cards, the sources and the deck metadata.

The ordinance, Sveriges nationalparker, Naturvårdsregistret and Wikidata agree on the same 31 parks, and the counties agree for every park. The years agree in all sources except Naturvårdsregistret's decision date for Haparanda skärgård (1994, the park dates from 1995). The other differences are in name forms, in the exact dates (decision or entry into force), in Naturvårdsregistret naming only the managing county for the two parks in several counties, and in which municipalities Wikidata lists; none changes a card. No Wikidata check had to be skipped, but several Wikidata labels differ from the official names and are therefore not used as checks. The brief's province (landskap) back was replaced by the county.

| Card | Issue | Resolution | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| (deck) | The brief asked for the province (landskap) on the back. None of the ordinance, Naturvårdsregistret, Sveriges nationalparker or Wikidata records the parks' provinces (query 3: only Kosterhavet has a P276 Bohuslän statement); provinces would have had to be inferred from maps for several parks or taken from the Swedish Wikipedia (CC BY-SA), and some parks cross province borders. | The back is the county (län), which the ordinance (3 §), Naturvårdsregistret, Sveriges nationalparker and Wikidata all give and the builder checks.
